# DTU Research Database (Orbit)

> > DTU Research Database is the institutional repository for the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), documenting research activities, publications, and academic events across scientific disciplines.

Orbit.dtu.dk serves as the comprehensive research information system for DTU, capturing conference presentations, lectures, workshops, and external collaborations. The database covers diverse fields including veterinary science, nanotechnology, physics, transport engineering, and life sciences, showcasing DTU's multidisciplinary research portfolio.

## Key Topics

- DTU Research Database
- Denmark
- Conference presentations
- Veterinary science
- Pig diseases
- Swine viral diseases (PPV, PRRS, PMWS)
- Classical swine fever virus
- Porcine health
- Animal virology
- Nanotechnology
- Academic events and workshops
- Life sciences
- Transport engineering
- International conferences
- Research collaboration

## Veterinary Science & Animal Health

- [Virussygdomme hos svin. PPV, svineinfluenza, PRRS samt porcint circovirus (PMWS)](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/virussygdomme-hos-svin-ppv-svineinfluenza-prrs-samt-porcint-circo): Guest lecture on swine viral diseases by Anette Bøtner
- [Virology Seminar](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/virology-seminar): Seminar on classical swine fever virus by Louise Lohse at DTU
- [Svineinfluenza](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/svineinfluenza): Swine influenza conference presentation by Anette Bøtner in Denmark
- [19th International Pig Veterinary Society Congress](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/19th-international-pig-veterinary-society-congress): Pig veterinary congress participation by Vibeke Sørensen Copenhagen
- [International Conference on the Haemophilus, Actinobacillus, Pasteurella Group of Organisms](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/international-conference-on-the-haemophilus-actinobacillus-pasteu): Bacterial organisms conference participation by Vibeke Sørensen 1989

## Nanotechnology & Materials Science

- [Statistical analysis of large areas of Raman mapped DNA functionalized gold coated silicon nanopillar SERS substrates](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/statistical-analysis-of-large-areas-of-raman-mapped-dna-functiona): Conference presentation on SERS substrates at ICAVS8 Vienna
- [Perforated SiN membrane resonators for nanomechanical IR spectroscopy](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/perforated-sin-membrane-resonators-for-nanomechanical-ir-spectros): Conference presentation on SiN membrane resonators by Kurek et al.
- [12th Joint MMM-Intermag Conference](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/12th-joint-mmm-intermag-conference): MMM-Intermag Conference participation by Daniel Kjær in Chicago

## Life Sciences & Biotechnology

- [12th International Conference on Miniaturized Systems for Chemistry and Life Sciences](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/12th-international-conference-on-miniaturized-systems-for-chemist-6): MicroTAS 2008 conference participation by Jörg Peter Kutter
- [Introduction to infectious disease modelling and its applications](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/introduction-to-infectious-disease-modelling-and-its-applications): Infectious disease modelling workshop in London by Per Kantsø Nielsen
- [Det Jordbrugsvidenskabelige fakultet: Svampe og mykotoksiner i majsensilage](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/det-jordbrugsvidenskabelige-fakultet-svampe-og-mykotoksiner-i-maj-2): Agricultural science presentation on fungi/mycotoxins in maize silage

## Physics & Engineering

- [61st Annual Meeting of the APS Division of Fluid Dynamics](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/61st-annual-meeting-of-the-aps-division-of-fluid-dynamics-3): APS Fluid Dynamics conference by Fridolin Okkels in San Antonio
- [On the Dynamics of the Fermi-Bose model](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/on-the-dynamics-of-the-fermi-bose-model): Conference presentation on Fermi-Bose model dynamics by Magnus Ögren
- [LED - fremtidens belysning](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/led-fremtidens-belysning-7): LED lighting conference/workshop by Dansk Center for Lys in Copenhagen

- [Transporttendenser 2030 ­ og udfordringer for Vejdirektoratet](https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/activities/transporttendenser-2030-og-udfordringer-for-vejdirektoratet): Transport trends 2030 leadership seminar for Vejdirektoratet Denmark
